dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: Hmph, he's just a trouble-making thief from hundreds of years ago. I have no idea why anyone would write stories about someone like that.

dialogues.speaker: Rahetar
dialogues.text: Stealing from the governor's palace, falling in love with the fae governor's adopted daughter, and even some utter claptrap about some holy lady of the Frostmoon Scions falling madly in love with him...
